overview: Peek into the gorilla habitat at Cleveland Metroparks, where two new babies are adapting to life in the troop.

overview: A vast community of chimpanzees thrives in a forest in Uganda, navigating complex social politics, family dynamics and dangerous territory disputes.

title: Dragons: Race to the Edge
overview: Unlock the secrets of the Dragon Eye and come face to face with more dragons than anyone has ever imagined as Hiccup, Toothless and the Dragon Riders soar to the edge of adventure.

overview: When My Melody's visit to the Cloud Kingdom leads to a whirlwind of trouble, can she, Kuromi and their friends save their home before it's too late?

overview: This nature series’ new technology lifts night’s veil to reveal the hidden lives of the world’s creatures, from lions on the hunt to bats on the wing.

title: Our Living World

title: Our Universe
overview: Witness the remarkable story of our universe over billions of years and its inextricable link to life on Earth in this sweeping documentary series.

title: Penguin Town

title: Pet Stars
overview: Follow talent management company Pets on Q as they work with the biggest animal influencers on social media in this reality series.

title: Ponysitters Club
overview: A young horse enthusiast teams up with her best friends to rescue and rehabilitate animals on her family's beloved ranch.

title: Pup Academy
overview: Welcome to a secret world where pups learn to be a human's best friend. Follow three unlikely puppies - and their human friends - as they work together to discover the power of friendship and create everlasting bonds between dogs and humans.

title: Rilakkuma's Theme Park Adventure
overview: Rilakkuma, Korilakkuma, Kiiroitori, and Kaoru are off on an adventure to the theme park, but with closing time imminent it leads to a series of fun mishaps and incidents as the group squeeze a day of fun into tiny amount of time.

She soon learns 2 bad witches, Wilma and Wanda are after her locket so they can have ultimate power, and she alongside her best friends Scout and Lily turn into cats to escape.

Having been marked with colourful flipper tags by researchers to observe their behavior, these round, squishy, and uniquely pattered creatures reveal a world that is anything but ordinary.

overview: Anthony Morgan explores the extraordinary ways that animals hear and produce sound, and the crucial role sound plays in the lives of animals around the globe - from birth to surviving adulthood and finding a mate.

overview: Shaun's seasonal excitement turns to dismay when a farmhouse raid to get bigger stockings for the flock inadvertently leads to Timmy going missing. Can Shaun get Timmy back before he becomes someone else’s present?

title: Super PupZ
overview: Four pups with superpowers team up to help their new friends and a furry alien comrade in this cuddly, cosmic adventure.

title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
overview: The Turtles — Leo, Raph, Donnie and Mikey — each will go it alone for the first time. Faced with new threats and teaming up with old allies, the Turtles will discover who they really are when they don’t have their brothers at their sides.

title: Beat Bugs: All Together Now
overview: After winning a local talent show, the Beat Bugs journey to compete on "The Bug Factor," a televised singing contest held in faraway Rocket Ship Park.

title: Bottersnikes & Gumbles

title: Care Bears: Unlock the Magic
overview: A group of lovable, huggable BFFs go on adventures and live that sweet Care Bear life. Through friendship, courage and a little belly badge magic, the Care Bears continue their mission to spread caring and sharing to the world.

title: Danger Mouse
overview: Danger Mouse is back saving London, saving the World and, most importantly, saving Penfold in brand new and fantastically absurd, energetic adventures.

overview: Young Horton explores the Jungle of Nool with his two best friends: going on daring adventures, helping their community, and learning how to stand up for what's fair.

overview: When a musical dragon with a beautiful voice hypnotizes the dragons and people of Huttsgalor, the Rescue Riders have to find a way to break the spell.

title: Hilda
overview: Fearless, free-spirited Hilda finds new friends, adventure and magical creatures when she leaves her enchanted forest home and journeys to the city.

title: Word Party Songs
overview: Sing along and dance with Bailey, Franny, Kip, Lulu and Tilly in this collection of music videos that will get you in the mood to move and groove!
